name: barbell-suitcase-carry
instructions:
1. Load a barbell and set up perpendicular to the bar.
2. Grasp the bar with a neutral grip and stand up straight.
3. While maintaining an active shoulder position, hold the barbell by your side and walk for a designated distance or amount of time.
starting_position: 1. Load a barbell and set up perpendicular to the bar. 2. Grasp the bar with a neutral grip and stand up straight.
